passage:
After a heavy rain, the small stream near school was full of water. Some students made paper boats and raced them during lunch break.
Most boats sank quickly. One boat, made by Linda, floated far down the stream. Everyone asked how she made it.
Linda said she had folded the paper many times before finding a good shape. She also used thicker paper from an old calendar.
The next day, more students brought different kinds of paper. They tested shapes, sizes, and folding methods. What began as a simple game became a science activity.
Their teacher watched and smiled. "You are learning like scientists," she said. "You try, fail, change something, and try again."
